title: GenAI Camera
hero_prompt: A wide technical ink engraving in the style of a Leonardo optical study: a woman stands beside a large wooden camera obscura box, light rays converging through its lens and re-emerging on the far wall as loose inked linework of a figure, the whole scene cross-sectioned in fine engraved lines.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast icon: a single camera-obscura lens as a solid black circle with a few radiating straight rays cut in thick strokes, no fine engraving, high contrast.
